description:
In repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/gap-to-feature.ts, make a narrowed gap carry the parent's failure lessons so the child is more informative than the parent it replaces.

ANCHOR. This exact line occurs EXACTLY ONCE in the file:
          summary: `[narrowed from ${parentId}] ${parentSummary.replace(/^\[narrowed from [\w:.!-]+\]\s*/g, "")}`,

ONE OPERATION. Replace that single line with exactly this single line:
          summary: "[narrowed from " + parentId + "] " + parentSummary.replace(/^\[narrowed from [\w:.!-]+\]\s*/g, "") + (Array.isArray((meta as Record<string, unknown>)["failure_lessons"]) && ((meta as Record<string, unknown>)["failure_lessons"] as unknown[]).length > 0 ? "\n\nWHY PREVIOUS ATTEMPTS ON THIS GAP FAILED (most recent last):\n" + ((meta as Record<string, unknown>)["failure_lessons"] as Array<Record<string, unknown>>).slice(-3).map((l) => "- " + String(l["class"] ?? "?") + ": " + String(l["reason"] ?? "").slice(0, 300)).join("\n") + "\n\nDo not repeat these failures. Address the specific cause named above." : ""),

Use plain string concatenation exactly as written. Do NOT use template literals or backticks anywhere in the replacement. Do NOT introduce any new local variable. Change nothing else — leave childMeta, the childRecord id, the surrounding branch and its comment untouched.

WHY. This is the chronic-failure narrowing branch. It fires only when a gap has already failed repeatedly, and the comment above it states "The child carries a tighter description" — but today the child summary is the parent's text with a prefix prepended, so the next attempt receives exactly the description that already failed at least three times. The prior failures are already recorded on the gap in classification_metadata.failure_lessons as {class, reason} entries, and `meta` is in scope here because it is spread into childMeta a few lines above, so this needs no extra read and no model call.

MEASURED JUSTIFICATION. Paired within-gap comparison over 259 parent/narrowed pairs: landing 7.3% (19/259) for parents versus 7.7% (20/259) for their narrowed children — a 0.4 percentage-point difference across 259 narrowing operations — while the share of summaries carrying a concrete proposed change rises only from 5% to 8%. Because the carried description is unchanged, no improvement is expected and none is observed.

SAFETY. The appended text is empty when there are no prior lessons, so for a gap with no failure history the summary is byte-identical to today's. Every value used is consumed in the same expression, so no unused local is introduced.

FALSIFIER. After this lands, read a newly created -narrowed gap and confirm its summary contains a "WHY PREVIOUS ATTEMPTS ON THIS GAP FAILED" section naming concrete failure classes, rather than only the parent's prose.
